svg.title: AWS vs Hetzner: Performance Density, Egress Economics and Operational Governance
svg.desc: Comparison of hyperscale managed cloud and bare-metal hosting. Details compute density, network egress pricing, operational boundaries and hybrid architectures.
svg.text: AWS vs Hetzner: Performance Density, Egress and Governance
Hyperscaler ecosystem abstraction versus dedicated bare-metal compute efficiency.
Compute density
Hetzner: Dedicated AMD EPYC cores
AWS: Burstable or multi-tenant vCPUs
Noisy neighbor & hypervisor delta
Network egress economics
AWS: ~$0.09/GB egress + NAT fees
Hetzner: 20 TB included, €1/TB after
Data transfer dominates high volume
Operational governance
AWS: Granular IAM, SOC2, Multi-AZ
Hetzner: Full host administrative root
Manual backups & hardware failover
AWS: Managed elastic cloud
Application Load Balancer across Multi-AZ
Auto Scaling Groups (EC2 / ECS Fargate)
Managed Multi-AZ RDS / Aurora failover
Integrated CloudWatch, KMS and IAM governance
Hidden costs: NAT Gateways, Cross-AZ data, EBS IOPS
Best for: Spiky demand, strict compliance, global reach
Hetzner: Dedicated bare metal / VPS
Direct NVMe PCIe 4.0/5.0 local disk throughput
Dedicated physical cores without hypervisor stealing
Unmetered or low-cost high-bandwidth network ports
Zero per-request API or gateway transfer surcharges
Operational cost: Team manages patching, RAID & DR
Best for: Predictable compute, CI/CD, high egress loads
The emerging compromise: Hybrid cloud architectures
Route data-heavy workloads, background workers and batch rendering to dedicated bare-metal servers.
Retain mission-critical relational persistence, IAM perimeter control and serverless burst in the hyperscaler.
Bridge environments via WireGuard or dedicated point-to-point tunnels to eliminate public internet exposure.
Optimize unit costs while preserving compliance boundaries and disaster recovery capabilities.
Source boundary: Pricing and performance depend on workload characteristics, region and contract terms.
Sysbench single-core runs do not model distributed network partitions, SLA guarantees or compliance audits.
Architecture & Design by Srinivasan Ragothaman (@rsrini7)
